people.name: Anak

people.name: Caleb
people.line: Faithful spy, given Hebron as inheritance

people.name: Hebron
people.line: An important city in Judah; burial place of patriarchs.

people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: They gave Hebron to Caleb, as Moses had said, and he drove the three sons of Anak out of there.
translations.bsb: Just as Moses had promised, Judah gave Hebron to Caleb, who drove out the descendants of the three sons of Anak.
translations.kjv: And they gave Hebron unto Caleb, as Moses said: and he expelled thence the three sons of Anak.
translations.asv: And they gave Hebron unto Caleb, as Moses had spoken: and he drove out thence the three sons of Anak.
